metaDescription: Order custom raglan baseball sports gear for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing and fast turnaround.
introHtml: Raglan baseball sleeves set your team apart with a classic athletic look that standard sleeves can't match. The contrasting shoulder panels offer greater range of motion, making them ideal for recreational leagues, company softball teams, or charity tournaments. Customize with your logo using screen printing or embroidery on durable polyester or cotton blends. Whether you need 24 jerseys for a department outing or 500 for a corporate sponsorship, raglan styles deliver a timeless, professional appearance that players appreciate.
